description: Whether a state conforms to IRC 168(k) bonus depreciation and IRC 179 for a tax year, its IRC conformity date, and the add-back or subtraction in plain terms. Unverified fields are null. Unknown states and years are not_covered.

state.description: Postal code or full state name. The District of Columbia is DC. New York City is NYC.

tax_year.description: Tax year, such as 2026. Files are tax-year specific.
